title: Traditional Irish Bubble and Squeak
description: A classic Irish dish made from leftover potatoes and cabbage, pan-fried to perfection. A hearty and comforting meal for any occasion.

ingredients.name: Northern Irish potatoes
ingredients.notes: preferably leftover from a previous meal

ingredients.name: Rich bubble and squeak
ingredients.notes: left over from a previous meal

instructions: Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until it starts to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the leftover bubble and squeak to the pan, breaking up any large clumps with a spatula.
Add the diced potatoes to the pan, stirring to combine with the cabbage and bubble and squeak.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently, until the potatoes are golden brown and crispy on the bottom.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Enjoy as a side dish or add to a breakfast plate with eggs and bacon.
